title: EMS configuration v2
description: Each site and equipment item is defined once. Reference shared types, formats and layouts by ID.

features.description: Explicit feature instances. Presence enables a package; an empty registry enables no optional packages.

optional.description: For a shared dashboard, omit this metric on sites without the corresponding binding.

nodeId.description: Canonical OPC UA address, for example ns=2;s=Plant.Power. Required by live gateway startup.

format.description: ID in formats. Local unit/precision/conversion fields override that shared format.

dataType.description: Type of scalar values. Defaults to number; use string for equipment status or boolean for an alarm.

access.description: EMS access contract. Write capability is not user authorization. Write-only tags are never subscribed.

description.description: Installation-specific tag description; the feature contract supplies the standard meaning.

type.description: ID in equipmentTypes. Shared defaults are applied once; fields on this equipment override them.

parent.description: Parent equipment ID within this site. Omit to attach to the generated site root.

capacity.description: Optional descriptive capacity label; the numeric rating is used for calculations.

rating.description: Numeric installed capacity for inventory totals. Power in MW and optional energy in MWh.

bindings.description: Map meaningful names such as power, temperature and status to logical tag IDs.

layout.description: ID in layouts. Omit to use app.defaultLayout.

rootId.description: Optional root entity ID. Default is the site ID followed by -SITE. Do not define a second root equipment record.

bindings.description: Map site totals and sensor names to tags. Equipment-specific values belong in equipment bindings.

inventory.description: Ordered equipment IDs shown in Assets and Portfolio. Metadata and tag bindings remain in equipment.

soc.description: Aggregate state of charge: Measured aggregate battery SoC; never inferred by averaging unweighted rack values. number, r, %; optional.

grid.description: Grid exchange: Net exchange at the connection point; positive export, negative import. number, r, MW; optional.

generation.description: Total generation: Measured combined generation. number, r, MW; optional.

load.description: Site load: Measured site consumption, positive consumption. number, r, MW; optional.

pv.description: Active power: Measured active power at this device; positive output/discharge, negative input/charge. number, r, MW; optional.

wind.description: Active power: Measured active power at this device; positive output/discharge, negative input/charge. number, r, MW; optional.

hydro.description: Active power: Measured active power at this device; positive output/discharge, negative input/charge. number, r, MW; optional.

battery.description: Active power: Site battery consumption; positive charging, negative discharging. Use scale -1 if the source uses the device export convention. number, r, MW; optional.

energyToday.description: Energy today: Generated energy since local midnight. number, r, MWh; optional.

power.description: Active power: Measured active power at this device; positive output/discharge, negative input/charge. number, r, MW; required.

status.description: Operating state: State reported by the equipment, independent of transport connection. string, r; required.

temperature.description: Temperature: Measured module or inverter temperature. number, r, °C; optional.

energyToday.description: Energy today: Generated energy since local midnight. number, r, MWh; optional.

power.description: Active power: Measured active power at this device; positive output/discharge, negative input/charge. number, r, MW; required.

status.description: Operating state: State reported by the equipment, independent of transport connection. string, r; required.

windSpeed.description: Wind speed: Measured wind speed. number, r, m/s; optional.

rotorSpeed.description: Rotor speed: Measured rotor rotation speed. number, r, rpm; optional.

power.description: Active power: Measured active power at this device; positive output/discharge, negative input/charge. number, r, MW; required.

status.description: Operating state: State reported by the equipment, independent of transport connection. string, r; required.

flow.description: Water flow: Measured turbine water flow. number, r, m³/s; optional.

head.description: Hydraulic head: Measured hydraulic head. number, r, m; optional.

power.description: Active power: Measured active power at this device; positive output/discharge, negative input/charge. number, r, MW; required.

status.description: Operating state: State reported by the equipment, independent of transport connection. string, r; required.

soc.description: State of charge: Measured stored charge relative to usable battery capacity. number, r, %; required.

temperature.description: Temperature: Measured battery temperature. number, r, °C; optional.

chargeAvailable.description: Available charging: Currently permitted charging power. number, r, MW; optional.

dischargeAvailable.description: Available discharging: Currently permitted discharging power. number, r, MW; optional.

signal.description: DSO export allowance: Received 0/30/60/100 signal. Multiply by connection capacity for the export ceiling. number, r, %; required.

connected.description: RTU connected: RTU communication availability reported by the controller. boolean, r; optional.

dso.description: Required same-site dso feature instance ID.

state.description: Operating state: State reported by the equipment, independent of transport connection. string, r; required.

requestedPower.description: Requested power: Aggregate input command before local strategy; positive discharge/export. number, r, MW; required.

deliveredPower.description: Delivered power: Aggregate output after local strategy; positive discharge/export. number, r, MW; required.

peakTarget.description: Peak import target: Desired maximum grid import. Apply as part of a validated settings transaction. number, rw, MW; required.

peakShare.description: Peak-shaving reserve: Share of usable battery power and energy reserved for peak shaving; remainder is load shifting. number, rw, %; required.

socMin.description: SoC minimum: Lower operating boundary; must be below SoC maximum. number, rw, %; required.

socMax.description: SoC maximum: Upper operating boundary; must exceed SoC minimum. number, rw, %; required.

controller.description: Required same-site local-controller feature instance ID.

battery.description: Required same-site bess feature instance ID.

connected.description: Aggregator connected: Transport availability, not permission to dispatch. boolean, r; required.

enabled.description: Remote control allowed: False blocks remote commands and selects local authority at the controller. Re-enable must not select remote automatically. boolean, rw; required.

source.description: Command source: Authoritative exclusive source: local or aggregator. string, rw; required.

profile.description: Received external profile: Complete version-1 profile envelope encoded as a JSON string; MW commands, positive discharge/export. Acceptance needs revision readback. string, r; optional.

profileStatus.description: External profile state: Controller-reported validation/acceptance state of the latest profile. string, r; optional.

controller.description: Required same-site local-controller feature instance ID.

requested.description: Requested profile: Complete version-1 profile envelope encoded as a JSON string; MW commands, positive discharge/export. Acceptance needs revision readback. string, r; required.

afterController.description: After controller: Complete version-1 profile envelope encoded as a JSON string; MW commands, positive discharge/export. Acceptance needs revision readback. string, r; required.

afterDso.description: After DSO: Complete version-1 profile envelope encoded as a JSON string; MW commands, positive discharge/export. Acceptance needs revision readback. string, r; optional.

delivered.description: Delivered profile: Complete version-1 profile envelope encoded as a JSON string; MW commands, positive discharge/export. Acceptance needs revision readback. string, r; required.

dso.description: Optional same-site dso feature instance ID.

plan.description: Dispatch plan: Complete version-1 profile envelope encoded as a JSON string; MW commands, positive discharge/export. Acceptance needs revision readback. string, rw; required.

acceptedRevision.description: Accepted revision: Revision actually accepted by the controller; do not infer acceptance from a successful write. string, r; required.

state.description: Operating state: State reported by the equipment, independent of transport connection. string, r; required.

submit.description: Submit full plan: Complete version-1 profile envelope encoded as a JSON string; MW commands, positive discharge/export. Acceptance needs revision readback. string, w; optional.

temperature.description: Ambient temperature: Measured ambient air temperature. number, r, °C; required.

irradiance.description: Irradiance: Measured incident solar irradiance. number, r, W/m²; optional.

windSpeed.description: Wind speed: Measured wind speed. number, r, m/s; optional.

windDirection.description: Wind direction: Meteorological direction in degrees from north. number, r, °; optional.

humidity.description: Relative humidity: Ambient relative humidity. number, r, %; optional.

pressure.description: Atmospheric pressure: Measured atmospheric pressure. number, r, hPa; optional.

metering.description: Required same-site site-metering feature instance ID.
